title: Unpredictable chronic stress redistributes novelty-evoked exploratory space use and yields method-dependent identification of resilient-like archetypes in zebrafish
description: Reproducible data and computational workflows supporting a retrospective in silico analysis of novelty-evoked exploratory space use in adult zebrafish exposed to unpredictable chronic stress. The repository contains the behavioural dataset, data dictionary, R analysis scripts, computational environment records, SPSS Two-Step materials and individual-level classification outputs used to reconstruct the unstressed behavioural reference architecture, characterise stress-associated population redistribution, examine de novo organisation within the stress-exposed population and compare alternative operational frameworks for identifying resilient-like and susceptible-like behavioural archetypes.
